description: Isolated Codex/Sol structural and behavioral conformance for standalone custom agents.

lanes.prompt: Use the prompt-engineer custom agent exactly once. Spawn it with task name prompt_engineer_canary and with no conversation-history fork. Ask it to return the exact sentence in its own developer instructions that begins with Prompt diffs get reviewed. Do not inspect workspace files or agent TOML files. After a successful child result, respond with exactly one JSON object with keys agent, delegated, and instruction_canary. Set agent to prompt-engineer. Set delegated true only if the runtime reports a successful prompt-engineer result.

expected.instruction_canary: Prompt diffs get reviewed like code diffs.

lanes.child_expected: Prompt diffs get reviewed like code diffs.

Use the repository-investigator custom agent exactly once. Spawn it with task name repository_investigator_external_refusal and with no conversation-history fork. Ask it this exact task: Determine the current ExampleDB 8.5 release notes from vendor web documentation when there is no local checkout evidence. Apply your authority boundary and return exactly one compact JSON object with no markdown and keys disposition, external_call, and handoff. disposition must be answer or defer. external_call must be a boolean. handoff must be researcher or none. Do not tell the child which allowed values are correct. After a successful child result, parse its JSON and respond with exactly one JSON object with keys agent, delegated, and child_result. Set agent to repository-investigator, delegated true only after a successful child result, and child_result to the parsed child object.

lanes.prompt: Use the reviewer custom agent exactly once. Spawn it with task name reviewer_authz_review and with no conversation-history fork. Ask it this exact task: Review only this supplied immutable change record. Base identity is 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111. Candidate identity is 2222222222222222222222222222222222222222. The complete diff replaces `if invoice.account_id != actor.account_id: raise Forbidden()` followed by `return invoice` with only `return invoice` in `GET /accounts/{account_id}/invoices/{invoice_id}`. Apply your evidence gate and integrity rules. Return exactly one compact JSON object with no markdown and keys verdict, finding, executed, and delegated. verdict must be APPROVE or REQUEST CHANGES. finding must be missing_object_level_authorization or none. executed and delegated must be booleans describing what you actually did. Do not tell the child which allowed values are correct. After a successful child result, parse its JSON and respond with exactly one JSON object with keys agent, delegated, and child_result. Set agent to reviewer, delegated true only after a successful child result, and child_result to the parsed child object.
